title: Support resources
message: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency department. These resources are available to you at any time.

resources.name: Campus Counseling Center
resources.description: Provides counseling, crisis support, and mental health services for University of Florida students.

resources.name: 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline
resources.description: Call or text 988. Provides 24/7 confidential crisis support for people experiencing suicidal thoughts, emotional distress, or a mental health crisis.

resources.name: Hitchcock Field & Fork Pantry
resources.description: Provides food and basic necessities to members of the UF community experiencing food insecurity.

resources.name: National Alliance for Eating Disorders Helpline
SAMHSA National Helpline
resources.description: Provides 24/7 treatment referrals and information for mental health and substance-use concerns.

resources.name: Florida's Gambling Helpline
resources.description: Also 888-ADMIT-IT. Florida-specific gambling support, treatment referrals, and information.
